27:t_1:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's so mean, $$アルト$$! Why did you sortie and leave us behind in Japan!?」

27:t_1:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I heard from Director $$大塚$$. That all of you had been fighting on the Central Asian front.」

27:t_1:10.en:
$n
「I'm sorry I sortied without telling you. I wanted you two to protect Japan.」

27:t_1:11.en:
$n
「With $$シンジ$$ and the others back at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, and $$カレン$$ and $$竜馬$$ away from Japan right now, I can't very well send you two out as well.」

27:t_1:12.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Geez... If you'd just said so in the first place, I would have understood.」

27:t_1:13.en:
$n
「My bad. I'll treat you to Trident-yaki next time, so cut me some slack.」

27:t_1:14.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's a promise. If you forget, I won't forgive you.」

27:t_1:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Well then, we're off to school, so excuse us. But next time, we'll definitely sortie too.」

27:t_1:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「See you, everyone! Say hi to Miss $$スズネ$$ for us!」

27:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ワッ太$$'s one thing, but it looks like we couldn't fool $$正太郎$$.」

27:t_1:22.en:
$n
「There's no way we can beat an ace $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ investigator.」

27:t_1:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「The battles ahead will get even harsher... We can't take those two into that.」

27:t_1:25.en:
$n
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ will concentrate on defense... That's what we all agreed on.」

27:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Do you think I'm being too soft?」

27:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. It's the right decision.」

27:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「...What you said before... About not bringing battle into everyday life. I feel like I've recently started to understand what you meant.」

27:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah... I'm just glad you're all safe.」

27:t_1:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, everyone... Did you write them properly? Your post-graduation career plan forms.」

27:t_1:38.en:
$$さやか$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ told us too, but...」

27:t_1:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「From the look of you, I'd say none of you did.」

27:t_1:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There's still time before morning homeroom, so let's just knock them out quick.」

27:t_1:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well then, let's go. The whole class has been wanting to see the Volunteer Club members.」

27:t_1:46.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's our first day at school in ten days, after all.」

27:t_1:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Exactly. Well then, let's go in full of energy.」

27:t_1:49.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$'s cheerfulness is a real lifesaver.」

27:t_1:51.en:
$n
「...$$宗介$$. Make sure you protect her.」

27:t_1:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「What is it, $n? Out of nowhere...」

27:t_1:53.en:
$n
「...I don't know. I just thought so, somehow.」

27:t_1:61.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「You guys... No matter where you were, you could have at least written a career plan.」

27:t_1:62.en:
$$甲児$$
「Can't be helped. We were busy with a lot of things.」

27:t_1:63.en:
$$詩織$$
「What trash were you picking up this time?」

27:t_1:64.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Listen, $$詩織$$... The Volunteer Club's activities aren't just picking up trash, you know...」

27:t_1:67.en:
$$アルト$$
「I've explained it plenty of times...!」

27:t_1:68.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「If I can hear $$アルト$$ snapping back with his comebacks, I can relax.」

27:t_1:70.en:
$$詩織$$
「Believe it or not, I was worried. You're all in danger of being held back a year, and yet all you do is volunteer work...」

27:t_1:71.en:
$$詩織$$
「The few times you did come to school, you looked kind of exhausted.」

27:t_1:73.en:
$$さやか$$
「...Thank you. Sorry for making you worry.」

27:t_1:74.en:
$$詩織$$
「Of course, $$さやか$$. We're classmates... friends, after all.」

27:t_1:75.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Right, right. Besides, if you don't do your best, who's going to fix the leaky roof of the bike shed?」

27:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's what it comes down to, after all!?」

27:t_1:77.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「That's the spirit. I'm counting on you, Volunteer Club president.」

27:t_1:80.en:
$$風間$$
「...I've been wondering for a while, but $$竹尾ワッ太$$ is a member of the Volunteer Club too, isn't he?」

27:t_1:81.en:
$$恭子$$
「The little elementary school president who's always so energetic, right?」

27:t_1:82.en:
$$風間$$
「It seems $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$'s $$トライダーＧ７$$ fought all over the place in the 《$$時獄戦役$$》 too, but...」

27:t_1:83.en:
$$風間$$
「Could it be that $$相良$$ and everyone in the Volunteer Club were out there fighting too...」

27:t_1:84.en:
$$恭子$$
「You really do love that kind of talk, $$風間$$.」

27:t_1:85.en:
$$恭子$$
「You're overthinking it. $$カナ$$-chan even said $$相良$$ is just a war maniac.」

千鳥.evidence: Kaname Chidori's surname (glossary has 千鳥かなめ = Kaname Chidori; same token already used in dlg_2002_00/01); Alto, Hibiki and Sousuke address her as Chidori

相良.evidence: Sousuke Sagara's surname (glossary has 相良宗介 = Sousuke Sagara); Kazama calls him 相良君 and Kyoko calls him 相良君 in t_1:83/85

カナ.evidence: Nickname カナちゃん used by Kyoko for Kaname (かなめ = Kaname); written $$カナ$$-chan

27:t_1:49: 'is a real lifesaver' - kept impersonal (who is saved: speaker/group)
27:t_1:83: Kazama's trailing 'too...' completed as 'were out there fighting too' from the previous line
